comment: The two pattern-stepping buttons are the wrong way round against their own tooltips: BUTTONUP_PARAM is named "Prev Theka" at Tala.cpp:140 and raises currentTheka at line 405, while BUTTONDOWN_PARAM is named "Next Theka" at line 141 and lowers it at line 410. The reset test at line 327 reads `if (currentResetTrig && !prevClockTrig)`, comparing the reset edge against the clock's previous state rather than the reset's own, so a reset arriving on the same sample as a clock is dropped. The interpolation buffer at line 119 is sized for 192kHz, which is the maker's stated ceiling. The accent gate is fixed at 0.125 seconds (line 250).
